claims.claim: Chapter I introduces the Darling family at 14 and the nursemaid Nana, a dog
claims.evidence: 'Of course they lived at 14'; 'prim Newfoundland dog, called Nana'

claims.claim: Wendy first learned she would grow up (at age two)
claims.evidence: 'One day when she was two years old she was playing in a garden... you must grow up'

claims.claim: Wendy talks of a boy named Peter who visits the nursery at night
claims.evidence: Wendy assures her mother 'he is just my size'; leaves found on the nursery floor

claims.claim: Mrs. Darling finds strange leaves and dreams of him
claims.evidence: 'Some leaves of a tree had been found on the nursery floor'; 'She dreamt that the Neverland had come too near and that a strange boy had broken through'

claims.claim: Peter, a boy who will not grow up, loses his shadow in the nursery
claims.evidence: Chapter II 'The Shadow': 'proved to be the boy's shadow'

claims.claim: He teaches Wendy, John and Michael to fly and they follow him to Neverland
claims.evidence: the flight chapters; Jane later asked 'the famous flight had taken place'

claims.claim: They meet lost boys, mermaids and Tiger Lily, and face Captain Hook and his pirates
claims.evidence: Chapter 'The Mermaids' Lagoon'; Tootles, Curly, Slightly, Twin; Hook and crocodile

claims.claim: Wendy becomes a mother to the boys
claims.evidence: 'She told Peter that she had adopted all the other boys'; Wendy as mother in the Home Under the Ground

claims.claim: Hook captures them and plans to poison Peter
claims.evidence: Hook adds 'Five drops' of poison to 'Peter's cup'
'It was poisoned, Peter... and now I am going to be dead'

claims.claim: In a duel Hook falls to the crocodile
Mr. and Mrs. Darling adopt the lost boys
claims.evidence: Mrs. Darling adopts them; Mr. Darling 'would find space for them all in the drawing-room'

claims.claim: Years later Wendy is grown and Peter takes her daughter Jane to Neverland
claims.evidence: 'Jane... Peter... rose in the air, and the shameless Jane rose with him'

claims.claim: Characters: Wendy eldest Darling child; Tinker Bell jealous fairy; Hook has an iron hook
claims.evidence: Wendy introduced first of the children; Tinker Bell passages; Hook's iron claw
